name: CHIME (Penn Medicine)
description: Penn Medicine's COVID-19 Hospital Impact Model for Epidemics, a free open-source web-based tool for hospital surge capacity planning. Uses SIR-based epidemic modeling with Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification to project ICU admissions, hospitalizations, and ventilator needs under varying epidemic scenarios and intervention assumptions. Designed for rapid deployment by hospital systems to inform capacity planning and resource procurement during COVID-19 and future pandemic events.
general_score_metric: projection error (e.g., MAE / RMSE on projected hospitalizations, ICU admissions, ventilator needs)
reputation: Widely adopted hospital surge planning tool during COVID-19; freely available and rapidly deployed by hundreds of health systems
notes: Open source on GitHub. Web application at penn-chime.phl.io. Rapidly developed and deployed in March 2020 during the early COVID-19 pandemic. Used by hundreds of U.S. health systems for planning. Published in Annals of Internal Medicine (2020).
